method: Parse all TOML into typed structures; compare per-ID maps and fields. Parse all 733 upstream program bodies through github.com/expr-lang/expr v1.17.8 parser.Parse and ast.Walk without evaluating any program. No call inference from string matching.

execution_disposition.offline: All 18 parsed call names are implemented in expr_filter or secret_tokenizer, with compiled programs evaluated only in the bounded Python worker.
execution_disposition.provider_actions: validate/analyze/revoke program strings remain inert metadata. Neither the Python scanner nor this AST inventory executes them. Provider-only functions are not in the offline allowlist.
execution_disposition.legacy: Legacy unprofiled CEL grammar stays in cel_filter.py and is covered using baseline.toml; it is not passed to the Expr parser.
